hypothesis: NVIDIAのFY2027残期間92B USD commitmentを1.0x cash coverするために不足する7.106B USDは、Q3/Q4 revenueを108B USDで据え置いても、H1で観測されたaccounts receivable cash outflowの一部正常化だけで埋められる。

decision_rule.use_if: 必要cash gapがprior Q1-revenue-scaled AR normalization potential以下で、かつ後続reported cash flowで同等以上のAR回収またはFCF conversion改善が実現している。
decision_rule.condition_if: 必要cash gapがprior AR normalization potential以下だが、後続reported cash realizationはまだ観測されていない。
decision_rule.reject_if: 必要cash gapがprior AR normalization potentialを上回り、inventory/customer advances等の追加仮定なしでは1.0x coverageに届かない。
decision_rule.unverified_if: 92B USD commitment、Q3 guidance、reported H1 FCF margin、またはH1 working-capital cash-flow line itemsが一次情報で確認できない。

capital_allocation_importance: 前回研究でQ3/Q4を108B USDとした場合の1.0x cash coverage閾値はH2 FCF margin 42.5926%、reported H1 margin 39.3028%との差は3.2897ptと分かった。今回はその差額をworking-capital cash-flow line itemsへ分解し、追加成長ではなくcash conversionだけで埋められるかを判定する。
primary_sources: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Form 10-Q, quarter ended 2026-07-26: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000075/nvda-20260726.htm

method.point_in_time: Use issuer information available through 2026-08-26 and previously merged canonical threshold artifacts. No Q3 actual or later reported cash flow is used.
method.base_case: Hold Q3 and Q4 revenue at 108B USD each, matching the prior canonical threshold study, so H2 revenue is 216B USD. Keep reported H1 FCF margin 39.302845% as the no-recovery benchmark.
method.cash_gap: cash gap = 92B commitment - 216B * reported H1 FCF margin.
method.working_capital_bridge: Compare the cash gap with H1 reported cash-flow effects from accounts receivable and inventories. Customer advances are treated separately using disclosed additions less revenue recognized; they are not silently netted into another line-item assumption.
method.alternative_hypotheses: Test AR recovery only, inventory unwind only, customer-advance net addition only, and customer-advance net addition plus AR recovery. Compare with the prior Q1-revenue-scaled AR normalization potential of 15.063449B USD.
method.risk_metrics: NOT_APPLICABLE: point-in-time fundamental cash-conversion threshold research, not a trading-strategy backtest.

benchmark_and_alternative.simple_benchmark: No working-capital recovery: H2 FCF remains 84.894B USD at the H1 reported FCF margin, leaving a 7.106B USD shortfall and 0.9228x coverage.
benchmark_and_alternative.ar_only: A 7.106B USD AR recovery is sufficient. It equals 28.90% of the H1 AR cash outflow and 47.17% of the prior Q1-scaled AR normalization potential.
benchmark_and_alternative.inventory_only: Inventory alone could bridge the gap only if 69.64% of the H1 inventory cash outflow reverses; this is materially more demanding than the AR-only bridge.
benchmark_and_alternative.customer_advances_only: The H1 net customer-advance addition of 2.6B USD covers only 36.59% of the gap and is insufficient alone.
benchmark_and_alternative.combined: If another 2.6B USD customer-advance net addition occurred, only 4.506B USD of AR recovery would remain necessary, equal to 18.32% of the H1 AR cash outflow. This is a sensitivity, not a forecast.

verdict.reason: The 7.106B USD cash gap is smaller than both the H1 AR cash outflow (24.590B USD) and the prior Q1-revenue-scaled AR normalization potential (15.063B USD). Therefore no Q4 revenue upside or inventory unwind is mathematically required if AR collection improves. However no Q3/Q4 reported cash realization exists yet, so the feasibility result cannot be upgraded to USE.
verdict.capital_allocation_implication: Use 7.106B USD of H2 incremental cash conversion, or equivalently 3.2897pt of FCF-margin recovery at 216B USD H2 revenue, as the near-term decision threshold. Treat AR collection as the lowest-assumption bridge because only 28.90% of the H1 AR cash outflow must reverse; do not assume the recovery has occurred until reported cash flow confirms it.

implementation.delete_or_cleanup: No dedicated code/config/workflow/one-off script created; no cleanup required.

limitations: The 7.106B USD AR recovery is a required threshold, not company guidance or realized cash flow.
H1 cash-flow line items cover six months and cannot identify exactly which quarter or customer will reverse working capital.

Customer advances are disclosed within deferred revenue; the 2.6B USD net addition is additions less revenue recognized and is used only as a sensitivity, not as an independent cash-flow line-item forecast.
Supply/capacity commitments are not identical to same-period cash payments; the 92B USD amount is used consistently with the prior economic-capacity diagnostic.
Q3 revenue is company guidance and Q4 is a flat-Q3 benchmark, not realized revenue.
next_high_value_hypothesis: NVIDIAのAR回収7.106B USDという閾値を、顧客集中度と90日から最長1年のextended payment termsに照らしてstressし、主要顧客の支払期間が長期化したままでもFY2027残期間cash coverage 1.0xを達成できるかを検証する。
